26.1.2 is a hotfix for Java Edition released on April 9, 2026,[1] which tweaks UI checkboxes and fixes an exploit. It is compatible with 26.1 and 26.1.1 servers.

Contents

  • 1 Changes
    • 1.1 General
  • 2 Fixes
  • 3 Videos
  • 4 Trivia
  • 5 References
  • 6 Navigation

Changes

[edit | edit source]

General

[edit | edit source]

UI

  • Check message tooltip is now displayed only when text overflows past 2 rows.
  • Confirmation checkbox in Report Player screen now displays tooltip with same text as message.

Fixes

[edit | edit source]
  • Fixed players in Spectator mode being able to attack other players.

Videos

[edit | edit source]
Video made by slicedlime:

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • This version was released on the same day as 26.2 Snapshot 2.
